facts.text: John participated in a marching event for veterans' rights on 3 July 2023.

evidence.quote: I just participated in a marching event for veterans' rights and it was awesome, made me remember how much they sacrifice for us.

facts.text: John expressed respect for the military and a desire to show support for veterans' rights.

evidence.quote: I've always had a great respect for our military and wanted to show my support.

facts.text: John felt motivated by the shared values and passion of others during the veterans' rights event.

evidence.quote: It reminded me how important it is to try and make a difference through activism. It really motivated me.
